description: Call each declared measure endpoint, assert the response conforms to its declared `result` shape, and round-trip one `questions[]` example end-to-end (match → extract → execute → plausible); a hollow declaration (404 or non-conforming response) is an ERROR, proving real adoption rather than mere declaration.

requirements.description: Implement a behavioral adoption probe that calls each declared measure endpoint from a scenario's manifest, asserts the HTTP response conforms to the declared `result` shape (schema validation), and round-trips one `questions[]` example end-to-end: match the question, extract parameters via LLMExtractor, execute via HTTPExecutor, and assert the result is plausible. A 404 response or a response that does not conform to the declared result shape must be classified as ERROR, proving real adoption rather than mere declaration. The probe must reuse packages/measures-go (LLMExtractor, HTTPExecutor) and must not re-author measure execution logic.
requirements.title: Behavioral Adoption Probe for Declared Measure Endpoints
